sources.title: History of the Georgia Forestry Commission

notes_for_editor: Existence and location rest on one hobby list (tnlandforms.us, revised 2016). No register, agency, survey or news source found for this tower; web searches turned up nothing, and no NGS survey mark is linked to this point in the list. The list's elevation heading has no unit; the story's 275.8 m conversion assumes feet, so it is marked as an assumption. The story states only what the sources support; the list's name matches the Rockdale town of Conyers, and nothing links the tower to the railroad or the town's history. The Rockdale history page is about the town; it does not mention a tower. Worth asking the Rockdale County Historical Society or Georgia Forestry Commission records whether a tower stood here.
